newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco injects 260 mln dirhams into money market.
newsitem.headline: Morocco injects 260 mln dirhams into money market.

text.p: Morocco's bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 260 million dirhams into the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Friday.

The bank received bids totalling 5.338 billion dirhams and allocated 2.560 billion dirhams at seven percent interest rate. That was more than the 2.300 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the bank said.
It satisfied 47.96 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on October 23, 1996, it added.
